content_sections.heading: NRLM Block Manager - Non-Farm Livelihood Job Description
content_sections.text: Undertake the implementation of project activities as per respective Annual Action Plan under the NRLM / NRETP / SVEP - Non-Farm thematic at the block level. Create various data sets of enterprises and entrepreneurs at the block including the baseline survey of existing enterprises; ensure that this data is updated at regular intervals in appropriate MISs. Ensure provision of Business Support Services to the entrepreneurs in the block. Ensure necessary marketing avenues to the entrepreneurs in the block, especially through monthly markets, kiosks, e-commerce, supply to bulk buyers etc. Ensure that Enterprises has the required technical information for the production / services that need to rendered. Ensure that financial requirement of enterprises are met through CIF, CEF, Mudra loans etc. Coordinate amongst STLF, GPLFs, WLFs and SHGs and project staff for effective implementation. Assist identification and selection of Community Cadre for Non - Farm activities. Support the STLF and GPLFs in operationalizing the various activities under the programme and building their capacities, especially Livelihood Sub Committees to take over all the non-farm programme elements. Identify new business opportunities and markets for setting up enterprises. Identify potential entrepreneurs from the block and ensure EDP and Skill Training are provided to them in coordination with DMMU and Skill Training Agencies / RSETIs. Ensure regular monitoring and reporting of entrepreneurship development activities in the block. Ensure that both the quantitative and qualitative targets are met as per AAP. Ensure MIS and monitoring reports are submitted as per the defined timelines and submit monthly reports on prescribed formats. Provide handholding and business management support to the clusters / incubated enterprises being supported in the block. Work with Technical Support Agencies, Start-Ups, Incubators, NGOs etc to meet project objectives. Documentation of case studies, best practices, and learning notes throughout project implementation. Any other task given by supervisor and TMMU / DMMU / SMMU.
